/.title: KKKCreations — Bespoke tailoring in Bhutan
/.description: Discover KKKCreations, the Paro tailoring studio founded by Thinley Wangmo and Kinley Dema. Explore made-to-measure Bhutanese design and request a fitting.

/collections/men.description: Explore men’s suits, jackets and shirts made to your measurements in Bhutan. Choose a house silhouette or bring your own design and preferred fabric.

/collections/women.title: Women’s made-to-measure collection | KKKCreations Bhutan
/collections/women.description: Explore women’s tailored jackets, suits and shirts from KKKCreations in Bhutan. Create your own fit with a house design or a reference of your own.

/artists.description: Meet KKKCreations founders Thinley Wangmo and Kinley Dema, 2 sisters carrying their father Kado’s tailoring legacy into contemporary Bhutanese fashion.
